title: Await an asynchronous call
description: This program defines asynchronous functions and starts the outer one with asyncio.run.

steps.description: fetch is an async function. It awaits a short sleep as a stand-in for waiting on a server, then returns text with its name.
main awaits fetch inside another async function and prints its returned text.

steps.question: What text does fetch return when main passes tools?

steps.description: asyncio.run starts main. The program prints got tools.
